manifest_row.title: California blasts Trump proposal to freeze fuel-efficiency standards

screening.main_topic: The dispute over the Trump administration’s proposed freeze of vehicle fuel-efficiency and emissions standards
screening.climate_relevance: The article directly discusses greenhouse-gas emissions, climate impacts, and the role of fuel-efficiency and clean-car standards in combating climate change. It also reports competing claims about the climate effects of the proposed rollback.
screening.reason: Climate change is a substantial part of the policy debate described: California argues the rollback would forfeit an opportunity to fight climate change, while the administration downplays its effect on warming. The main subject is vehicle standards, but their climate implications are central to the article’s coverage.
